text: Practice an information diet. Set aside one day (or at least half a day) a week when you completely renounce the use of the internet, social networks, television, radio, books, and even the phone. At the same time, do not go into the bustle of tasks, but direct attention into silence, explore your inner space. This is a simple practice, powerfully cleansing and “rebooting” the mind, restoring its capacity for deep concentration and perception of life as something real. During this time you can receive the most important insights, become aware of new meanings, and make decisions about leaving situations, projects, processes that are not interesting to you...
